preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100000.
The integer K must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must contain only lowercase Latin letters.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string S' for each test case.
The length of the output string S' must be equal to the length of the input string S.

postconditions.expression: all(c in S_prime for c in S)
postconditions.description: The output string S' must contain all characters from the input string S.
